questions.question: My launch page goes live tomorrow: will an assistant even see the FAQ at the bottom?
questions.quote: If your answer, your differentiator or your FAQ sits below the cut, the fix is not more words

questions.question: How many passages does it read from one page?
questions.quote: This reading takes at most 26 passages from a page.

questions.question: I wrote a long guide and nobody ever quotes the last sections. Why?
questions.quote: A retrieval system reads a fixed number of passages from a page and ignores the rest, so anything below that cut is invisible no matter how good it is.

questions.question: Can I check a page from my phone without installing anything?
questions.quote: A free allowance per visitor, no account needed.

questions.question: Does it keep a copy of the page I paste in?
questions.quote: The reading is kept briefly so it can be shared with a link, and the fetched page itself is not retained after the reading is produced.

questions.question: What's the difference between cutting at headings and cutting by meaning?
questions.quote: Heading-aware chunking cuts at the page's own headings; semantic chunking cuts where the meaning changes, whether or not there is a heading there.

questions.question: A client is asking right now why their page isn't in ChatGPT. Can this tell me if it's indexed?
questions.quote: This does not establish that any assistant has indexed the page.

questions.question: I'm comparing it with our own RAG chunker: what window size and overlap does it use?
questions.quote: The chunker (h2 cuts, then 2,000-character windows with 200 of overlap), the embedding model and the cap here are the ones the product runs in production.
